items: #431 Every cloud session is told its own link

The session-start hook now gives the link in any cloud session, not only project threads. The end-of-turn check keeps asking until a reply contains the link. Proved on this session, which had no link before. Commit 3245358.
#432 Every helper's full run is a file you can open

Each helper's prompt, every step with its result, and its report are saved to a file in work-trail/. Git ignores that folder. Proved on this session's real editor helper; the file was sent to you. Commit c121c80.
#433 Long or quiet calls wait for your yes

These are stopped until your next message says yes: background, detached and hidden commands, long waits, helper agents and Monitor watches. One yes lets one call through. Proved through the plugin's real entry point. A call was stopped, then let through once after a yes, then stopped again. Commit 2cd8d08.

The end-of-turn check requires an editor helper pass on every page. Under your decision 4A (a helper counts as a long call), each pass would wait for your yes. Each pass took 12 to 22 seconds, and its steps are now saved in work-trail/.
